correctness.rationale: Jacobi decomposition of unit-edge perfect binary-tree Laplacian gives non-radial P0=1,P1=λ-1,Pk=(λ-3)P(k-1)-2P(k-2), and radial Q(h+1)=(λ-2)Ph-2P(h-1). Recurrence at λ=1 vanishes exactly k≡1 mod4 and radial λ=1 exactly h≡3 mod4; the eigenspace multiplicity is M_h=∑_{j=0}^{⌊(h-1)/4⌋}2^{h-1-4j}+1_{h≡3 mod4}. PBH forces at least M_h independent coordinate controls. One selected leaf per bottom sibling pair kills all eigenvectors of λ≠1 by propagation. At λ=1 pair-sums have an m=2^{h-1}-dimensional antisymmetric kernel; choosing M_h-m linearly independent coordinate pivots of its image and adding the opposite leaves detects all unit eigenvectors. The matching all-h upper bound follows. Independently reconstructed exact Pk(1) recurrence through h=9 (1,2,5,8,17,34,69,136,273). At h=3 built 15x15 real Laplacian; no four-leaf set controllable, 32 of 56 five-leaf sets controllable.
